workflowSubtitle: A manager agent coordinates specialist agents in parallel, then validates, evidences, and scores findings before a human reviews the report.

workflowSpecialists.title: Recon Agent
workflowSpecialists.text: Maps assets, endpoints, identities, and the full attack surface.

workflowSpecialists.title: Authentication Agent
workflowSpecialists.text: Tests login flows, sessions, MFA, privilege boundaries, and access paths.

workflowSpecialists.title: API Security Agent
workflowSpecialists.text: Assesses APIs, authz, data exposure, and business-logic weaknesses.

workflowPipeline.title: Validation Agent
workflowPipeline.text: Confirms each finding is real, reproducible, and in scope.

workflowPipeline.title: Evidence Agent
workflowPipeline.text: Collects proof, screenshots, logs, and reproduction notes.

workflowPipeline.title: Severity Agent
workflowPipeline.text: Rates impact and likelihood using CVSS and business context.

workflowPipeline.title: Reporting Agent
workflowPipeline.text: Turns findings into a developer-ready report with fix guidance.

workflowPipeline.title: Human Review
workflowPipeline.text: A senior engineer reviews every finding before delivery.
